arxiv-2104-11688.creator: Quay Au *, Julia Herbinger *, Clemens Stachl, Bernd Bischl, Giuseppe Casalicchio
arxiv-2104-11688.description: Abstract Interpretable machine learning has become a very active area of research due to the rising popularity of machine learning algorithms and their inherently challenging interpretability. Most work in this area has been focused on the interpretation of single features in a model.

arxiv-2112-06713.title: Spreading, pinching, and coalescence: the Ohnesorge units
arxiv-2112-06713.creator: Marc A. Fardin, Mathieu Hautefeuille, Vivek Sharma
arxiv-2112-06713.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Marc A. Fardin, Mathieu Hautefeuille, Vivek Sharma. Understanding the kinematics and dynamics of spreading, pinching, and coalescence of drops is critically important for a diverse range of applications involving spraying, printing, coating, dispensing, emulsification, and atomization. Hence experimental studies visualize and characterize the increase in size over time for drops spreading over substrates, or liquid bridges between coalescing drops, or the decrease in the radius of pinching necks during drop formation.

arxiv-2406-06324.title: Navigating Unknowns: Deep learning robustness for gravitational wave signal reconstruction
arxiv-2406-06324.creator: Chayan Chatterjee, Karan Jani
arxiv-2406-06324.description: Abstract We present a rapid and reliable deep learning-based method for gravitational wave signal reconstruction from elusive, generic binary black hole mergers in LIGO data. We demonstrate that our model, AWaRe , effectively recovers gravitational waves with parameters it has not encountered during training.

arxiv-2510-21297.title: Jump risk premia in the presence of clustered jumps
arxiv-2510-21297.creator: Francis Liu Natalie Packham Artur Sepp
arxiv-2510-21297.description: Abstract This paper presents an option pricing model that incorporates clustered jumps using a bivariate Hawkes process. The process captures both self- and cross-excitation of positive and negative jumps, enabling the model to generate return dynamics with asymmetric, time-varying skewness and to produce positive or negative implied volatility skews.

arxiv-2512-04791.title: Anomalous impurity-induced charge modulations in black phosphorus
arxiv-2512-04791.creator: Byeongin Lee, Junho Bang, Sayan Banerjee, Jo a ~ \mathrm{\tilde{a}} o Augusto Sobral, Young Woo Choi, Claudia Felser, Mathias S. Scheurer, Jian-Feng Ge, Doohee Cho
arxiv-2512-04791.description: Abstract We observe anomalous charge modulations induced by ionized indium impurities on the surface of the semiconductor black phosphorus by scanning tunneling microscopy (STM). When the impurities are switched into a negatively charged state by the STM tip, periodic charge modulations emerge around the impurity center, but strictly confined by the nanoscale impurity potential.

pmc-10493023.title: The SIRT7-mediated deacetylation of CHD1L amplifies HIF-2α-dependent signal that drives renal cell carcinoma progression and sunitinib resistance
pmc-10493023.creator: Hongchao He, Jie Li, Wei Wang, Jie Cheng, Jian Zhou, Qunyi Li, Juan Jin, Li Chen
pmc-10493023.description: BackgroundAberrant interplay between epigenetic reprogramming and hypoxia signaling contributes to renal cell carcinoma progression and drug resistance, which is an essential hallmark. How the chromatin remodelers enhance RCC malignancy remains to be poorly understood. We aimed to elucidate the roles of CHD1L in determining hypoxia signaling activation and sunitinib resistance.

pmc-12386336.title: VEXAS Syndrome: Genetics, Gender Differences, Clinical Insights, Diagnostic Pitfalls, and Emerging Therapies
pmc-12386336.creator: Salvatore Corrao, Marta Moschetti, Salvatore Scibetta, Luigi Calvo, Annarita Giardina, Ignazio Cangemi, Carmela Zizzo, Paolo Colomba, Giovanni Duro
pmc-12386336.description: VEXAS syndrome (Vacuoles, E1-enzyme, X-linked, Autoinflammation, and Somatic) is a recently identified late-onset autoinflammatory disorder characterized by a unique interplay between hematological and inflammatory manifestations. It results from somatic mutations in the UBA1 gene, located on the short arm of the X chromosome. Initially, females were considered mere carriers, with the syndrome primarily affecting males over 50.

pmc-12428632.title: Integrative Evidence on Mulberry Extract for Modulating Metabolic Risk Factors Associated with Vascular Dementia
pmc-12428632.creator: Jui-Ting Yu, Chen-Pi Li, Yao Hsiao, Kuan-Po Cheng, Ru-Yin Tsai
pmc-12428632.description: Metabolic syndrome refers to a group of conditions that commonly occur together, including abdominal obesity, high blood pressure, elevated blood sugar, high triglyceride levels, and low high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL). These factors collectively increase the risk of cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and cognitive impairment.

pmc-13261456.title: Sand Production Mechanisms in Sandstone Gas Reservoirs during Cyclic Injection–Production with Variable Water Saturation
pmc-13261456.creator: Xiaoling Tang, Baomei Yang, Jinghong Hu, Yuan Zhang, Yidong Cai, Jun Lu
pmc-13261456.description: Formation water is common when using depleted reservoirs to build underground gas storage, which causes serious sand production problems during the periodic injection–production operation of natural gas. Current research focuses on the sand production of the reservoir in the single-phase case. Little attention is paid to the sand production caused by injection and production in water-bearing reservoirs.

pmc-13285120.title: Bioinspired Morphology‐Decoupled Soft Gripper with Enhanced Bidirectional Grasping Capability
pmc-13285120.creator: Yedong Huang, Dazhong Yu, Baijin Mao, Fangming Li, Juntian Qu
pmc-13285120.description: The integrated handling of dynamic and static targets remains a formidable challenge for soft grippers. Although cross‐modal grippers combine active and passive modes, they are constrained by inherent conflicts among precision, speed and strength, leading to bidirectional performance degradation. Here, inspired by principles of predation, we propose a strategy to decouple cross‐modal grasping via dual morphological configurations.

pmc-13319399.title: Appendix Mucinous Neoplasm
pmc-13319399.creator: Ping Xiao, Tao Xu, Ming Zhou, ZhenYu Lei
pmc-13319399.description: A 36‐year‐old female patient accepted the laparoscopic appendectomy; she was diagnosed with low‐grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm. There are no signs of recurrence after 4 years of follow‐up. We review and discuss the advanced literature on LAMN diagnosis and surgical treatment principles.

pmc-13328346.title: Cellular and molecular landscapes of human tendons across the lifespan revealed by spatial and single-cell transcriptomics
pmc-13328346.creator: Alina Kurjan, Jolet Y Mimpen, Lorenzo Ramos-Mucci, Ali C Aksu, Carla J Cohen, Mate Naszai, Christopher D Buckley, Adam P Cribbs, Mathew J Baldwin, Sarah JB Snelling
pmc-13328346.description: SummaryTendon injuries are common and heal poorly, whereas developing tendons repair with minimal scarring; how this capacity declines with age remains poorly understood. Here, we combine histology, single-nucleus, single-cell, and spatial transcriptomic profiling of human Achilles and quadriceps tendons across embryonic, fetal, and adult stages, including ruptured adult tendons.

uslaw-usc-t25-s102.title: 25 U.S.C. § 102 — Payment of costs for furnishing coal for Indian Service
uslaw-usc-t25-s102.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t25-s102.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 4 (Performance By United States Of Obligations To Indians); Subchapter I (Purchase Of Supplies). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The cost of inspection, storage, transportation, and so forth, of coal for the Indian Service shall be paid from the support fund of the school or agency for which the coal is purchased.
